## What's new

- ChaOS Pixel Names has a Transition Speed (Slow, Normal, Fast) for each
  UI Direction, in the menu only while that theme is on. Cubic starts on
  Fast, so the console name over the game comes and goes quicker.
- Rewinding now shows "Rewind" on screen while you hold MENU + L1.
- The fast forward, rewind, screenshot and achievement notices use the
  menus' look: their panel, the menu color border and the UI's text.
- The screenshot viewer's caption is a menu panel that fades after a
  moment to show the whole picture; left or right brings it back.
  Deleting asks with a Keep / Delete menu.
- PT's Shadow Direction is named by where the shadow lands: the names for
  up and down were the wrong way round.

---

ChaOS 0.10.2 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.10.2-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.10.2-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
